row.body: The guest-house key rack is marked full before the room inspection is signed. One water bottle is tagged for a room without a guest name.
row.title: Guest rooms before inspection

sidecar.gloss: A full room rack and an unnamed water delivery overlap.
sidecar.rival_reading: A work crew could use a guest room without a reservation; the rack does not show who stayed there.
